title: New employees missing monthly lunch credits after roster update
symptoms: Employees were added recently but some did not receive their monthly lunch allowance or credit allocation.
previous_resolution: Ops compared the roster batch with the assignment export, triggered a refresh, and confirmed the missing profiles after sync.
why_relevant: Same symptom: recently added employees are present in the client roster but not in the final credit assignment set.

title: Partial allocation gap after onboarding batch
symptoms: Bulk onboarding processed, but a subset of employees did not receive the expected lunch wallet amount.
previous_resolution: The team found the upload landed after the cutoff window; a manual refresh resolved the affected subset.
why_relevant: Useful precedent when the issue concerns a subset of new employees after a recent HR roster change.

title: Wallet refused at merchant outside eligible café network
symptoms: Employee attempted to use wallet balance at a merchant that was not part of the approved café or restaurant scope.
previous_resolution: Client-facing team explained the eligible merchant rule and supplied examples of accepted nearby partners.
why_relevant: Matches requests where a payment decline may be explained by merchant eligibility rather than a technical failure.

title: Client requested order change near the 48-hour modification deadline
symptoms: Corporate admin asked to move or change the next delivery order after the normal modification window.
previous_resolution: Ops checked the deadline. Because the request was still inside the grace window, the change was accepted and confirmed by email.
why_relevant: Relevant for timing-sensitive requests about delivery or meal-order modification rules.

title: Dietary preference update not reflected in current preview
symptoms: Employees updated vegetarian or allergen preferences, but the next order preview still displayed the previous meal composition.
previous_resolution: The team confirmed the update was submitted after the weekly lock and explained that the change would apply to the next cycle.
why_relevant: Matches timing questions where preference changes and order previews appear inconsistent.

title: Invoice variance questions often arrive without billing anchors
symptoms: Client reports an invoice mismatch but does not include invoice number, billing month, or variance type.
previous_resolution: Support requested the invoice reference and discrepancy type before routing to finance.
why_relevant: Good precedent for identifying when clarification is more useful than immediate escalation.
